# FreightClassPro — llms.txt
# Free LTL density calculator + freight tools. 100% client-side; no shipment data uploaded.

> FreightClassPro calculates NMFC density-based freight class (PCF → Class 50–400),
> looks up typical commodity classes, optimizes pallet loads, and generates BOL PDFs.
> Audience: logistics coordinators, warehouse managers, small-business shippers, drivers.

## Core tool
- LTL Density Calculator: https://freightclasspro.com/
  - Formula: Volume cu ft = (L×W×H in) / 1728. Density PCF = Weight lbs / Volume cu ft.
  - Metric: in = cm / 2.54, lbs = kg * 2.20462. Palletized floor: 48×40 in. Tare not auto-added.
  - 13-tier table: <1=400, 1–2=300, 2–4=250, 4–6=175, 6–8=125, 8–10=100, 10–12=92.5, 12–15=85, 15–22.5=70, 22.5–30=65, 30–35=60, 35–50=55, 50+=50.

## Tools
- Commodity Lookup (50+ estimates): https://freightclasspro.com/commodity-lookup
- Pallet Optimizer (metric + imperial): https://freightclasspro.com/pallet-optimizer
- BOL Generator (VICS short-form PDF): https://freightclasspro.com/bol-generator
- FAQ: https://freightclasspro.com/faq
